svg.title: WEC-SIM Python — primary
svg.desc: WEC-SIM Python, revision 17. Lighter helmet detail: two short, open, round-ended contours replace the connected crown band and shell seam. The existing helmet shell, brim, two nostrils, eye and cheek joins, body, rear-loop spacing, buoy, wave, lettering, palette and 8/3-unit line hierarchy are retained. Self-contained editable vector artwork.

g.data-purpose: Two short open helmet contours; no crown band or shell seam
